note: Eval parts other than the first 10 timestral-5M parts (run on the 2-core VM at commit dab1fd2) were produced on a Google Colab CPU runtime (session hw-pack-cpu, high-RAM shape, 8 cores reported by nproc, 50 GB RAM reported by free). 8 single-thread processes ran in parallel (OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, --threads 1).
hardware: Colab CPU runtime, High-RAM shape, 8 cores (nproc), about 50 GB RAM (free -g), no GPU

software.timestral: pip install git+https://github.com/mistralai/timestral.git (weights 5M and 28M from the Hugging Face hub)

commands: run_packing.py eval --group {t5m-fixed | learned t28m-fixed oracle reactive seasonal-naive ets arima} --shard i/8 --n-train 6 --n-test 3 --grid-stride 2 --subset-q 0.5,0.9,0.99 --threads 1 (i = 0..7; t5m-fixed first, then the other groups)
